claim: The Union Territory of Puducherry comprises four former French establishments: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam, which lie scattered in South India.

evidence.quote: comprises the former French establishments of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam, which lie scattered in South India

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, About Puducherry page

claim: Puducherry is bounded on the east by the Bay of Bengal and on the three sides by Tamil Nadu.

evidence.quote: bounded on the east by the Bay of Bengal and on the three sides by Tamil Nadu

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, About Puducherry page

claim: Mahe is on the Malabar coast, surrounded by Kerala.

evidence.quote: Mahe is situated on the Malabar coast on the Western Ghats surrounded by Kerala

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, About Puducherry page

claim: Yanam adjoins the East Godavari district of Andhra Pradesh.

evidence.quote: Yanam is situated adjoining the East Godavari district of Andhra Pradesh

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, About Puducherry page

claim: Karaikal lies on the East Coast, about 130 km south of Puducherry (official road-style figure, hedged).

evidence.quote: About 130 kms. south of Puducherry on the East Coast lies Karaikal

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, About Puducherry page

claim: The French possessions in India were de facto transferred to the Indian Union on 1 November 1954; the official page says Puducherry became officially part of India only in 1963, after the French Parliament ratified the treaty.

evidence.quote: On November 1, 1954, the French possessions in India were de facto transferred to the Indian Union

notes: Source line: Government of Puducherry, History page

claim: The UT has two districts: Puducherry district (Puducherry, Mahe and Yanam regions) and Karaikal district (Karaikal region), per the Directorate of Economics and Statistics.

evidence.quote: Puducherry District comprising of Puducherry, Mahe and Yanam regions and Karaikal District comprising of Karaikal region

notes: Source line: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Puducherry (An Overview of Puducherry, 2013)

claim: Our measurement: straight-line (great-circle) distances between the four main towns: Puducherry-Karaikal 113 km, Puducherry-Mahe 468 km, Puducherry-Yanam 592 km, Mahe-Yanam 911 km.
notes: Source line: method/pondy_distances.py (Natural Earth for Puducherry; OpenStreetMap town points for the other three)
